get_account_status.description: See the connected key's API-MMA plan, when it renews, and how many of today's requests are used and left. It is free: it never counts against the day.
get_account_status.name: get_account_status

active.description: True while the subscription is active.

requests_remaining.description: Requests left today; the day starts at midnight UTC.

subscription_end.description: When the plan renews or ends.

get_fight.description: Get one fight by ID: its event, weight class, status and the two fighters, the winner marked.
get_fight.name: get_fight

parameters.description: The fight's ID, such as 1361. List fights returns them.
parameters.name: fight_id

parameters.description: Optional. Give dates and times in this time zone, such as America/New_York or Europe/London. UTC when left empty.
parameters.name: timezone

category.description: The weight class, such as Lightweight.

date.description: When it starts, with the time zone's offset (ISO 8601).

event.description: The event, such as UFC 302: Makhachev vs. Poirier.

winner.description: True if they won. Both fighters are false until there is a winner, and stay false after a draw, a no contest or a cancelled fight.
True if they won. Both fighters are false until there is a winner, and stay false after a draw, a no contest or a cancelled fight.

main_card.description: True for a fight on the main card.

short.description: As a code: NS (not started), IN (intros), PF (pre-fight), WO (walkouts), LIVE (in progress), EOR (end of a round), FT (finished), CANC (cancelled) or PST (postponed).

time.description: Its start time, HH:MM, in that time zone.

timestamp.description: When it starts, as a Unix timestamp.

timezone.description: The time zone date and time are given in.

get_fighter_record.description: Get a fighter's professional record: wins, losses and draws, and the wins and losses by knockout and by submission.
get_fighter_record.display_str_template: Get the API-MMA record of fighter {0}.
get_fighter_record.name: get_fighter_record

parameters.description: The fighter's ID, such as 333 for Islam Makhachev. Find fighters looks one up.
parameters.name: fighter_id

knockouts.description: Fights won and lost by knockout.

submissions.description: Fights won and lost by submission.

list_bet_types.description: List the kinds of bet API-MMA has odds for, such as Home/Away or Over/Under, with the IDs the odds filter takes.
list_bet_types.name: list_bet_types

parameters.description: Optional. Only names containing this, at least 3 characters.
parameters.name: search

items.description: A bookmaker or a bet type.

id.description: Its ID, which the odds filters take.

list_bookmakers.description: List the bookmakers API-MMA has odds from, with the IDs the odds filter takes. These IDs are API-MMA's own: the same bookmaker can have another ID in another API-SPORTS API.
list_bookmakers.name: list_bookmakers

parameters.description: Optional. Only names containing this, at least 3 characters.
parameters.name: search

items.description: A bookmaker or a bet type.

id.description: Its ID, which the odds filters take.

list_categories.description: List the weight classes fights and fighters are filed under, such as Lightweight or Women's Strawweight, by the names the Weight class fields take.
list_categories.name: list_categories

parameters.description: Optional. Only names containing this, at least 3 characters.
parameters.name: search

list_fight_results.description: Get how a fight ended, or how every fight of a day did: the method (such as KO, SUB or Points), the round and time, the knockout or submission, and each judge's card after a decision.
list_fight_results.name: list_fight_results

parameters.description: Optional. Only this fight, such as 1361. Set this, or a date to read every fight of that day.
parameters.name: fight_id

parameters.description: Optional. Every fight on this day. The free plan takes only yesterday, today or tomorrow.
parameters.name: on_date

ko_type.description: For a knockout, how, such as Punches.

minute.description: The time into that round, such as 3:29.

scores.description: For a decision, each judge's card, such as 30-26.

sub_type.description: For a submission, which, such as D'Arce Choke.

target.description: The finish's target, when the API gives one.

won_type.description: How it was won, such as KO, SUB or Points (a decision).

list_fighter_statistics.description: Get each fighter's statistics in a fight, or in every fight of a day: strikes and power strikes to the head, body and legs, takedowns, submission attempts, control time and knockdowns.
list_fighter_statistics.name: list_fighter_statistics

parameters.description: Optional. Only this fight, such as 1361. Set this, or a date to read every fight of that day.
parameters.name: fight_id

parameters.description: Optional. Every fight on this day. The free plan takes only yesterday, today or tomorrow.
parameters.name: on_date

items.description: One fighter's work in one fight.

control_time.description: Time spent in control, minutes and seconds, such as 13:49.

list_fighters.description: Find fighters by name, weight class, team or ID, each with their nickname, height, weight, reach, stance and team.
list_fighters.name: list_fighters

parameters.description: Optional. Only this fighter, by ID, such as 333 for Islam Makhachev.
parameters.name: fighter_id

parameters.description: Optional. Only names containing this, at least 3 characters.
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Optional. Only this weight class, such as Lightweight. Pick one from the list.
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: Optional. Only the fighters of this team. Pick one from the list.
parameters.name: team_id

category.description: Their weight class, such as Bantamweight.

height.description: Their height in feet and inches, such as 5' 8".

height_inches.description: Their height in inches, such as 68.

id.description: The fighter's ID, such as 333 for Islam Makhachev.

last_update.description: When the API last updated them.

nickname.description: Their nickname, such as The Maniac.

reach_inches.description: Their reach in inches, such as 69.

id.description: The team's ID, such as 163 for Eagles MMA.

weight_pounds.description: Their weight in pounds, such as 136.

list_fights.description: List a day's or a season's fights, or only one fighter's or one weight class's, each with its event, weight class, status and the two fighters, the winner marked.
list_fights.name: list_fights

parameters.description: Optional. Only fights on this day, in the time zone chosen below. Set this or a season. The free plan takes only yesterday, today or tomorrow.

parameters.description: Optional. Only this season, such as 2024. Set this or a date. The free plan reads the 2022 to 2024 seasons.
parameters.name: season

parameters.description: Optional. Only this fighter, by ID, such as 333 for Islam Makhachev.
parameters.name: fighter_id

parameters.description: Optional. Only this weight class, such as Lightweight. Pick one from the list.
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: Optional. Give dates and times in this time zone, such as America/New_York or Europe/London. UTC when left empty.
parameters.name: timezone

date.description: When it starts, with the time zone's offset (ISO 8601).

event.description: The event, such as UFC 302: Makhachev vs. Poirier.

list_odds.description: Get bookmakers' pre-match odds for a fight, or for every fight of a day, optionally from one bookmaker or for one bet type. Odds appear 1 to 7 days before a fight, are updated four times a day and are kept for 7 days after it.
list_odds.name: list_odds

parameters.description: Optional. Only this fight, such as 1361. Set this, or a date to read every fight of that day.
parameters.name: fight_id

parameters.description: Optional. Every fight on this day. The free plan takes only yesterday, today or tomorrow.
parameters.name: on_date

parameters.description: Optional. Only this bookmaker's odds. Pick one from the list.
parameters.name: bookmaker_id

parameters.description: Optional. Only this kind of bet, such as Home/Away. Pick one from the list.
parameters.name: bet_id

id.description: Its ID, which the odds filters take.

values.description: Each outcome and its decimal odds.

value.description: The outcome, such as Home, Away or Draw.

id.description: Its ID, which the odds filters take.

fight_id.description: The fight's ID, which Get a fight takes.

list_seasons.description: List the seasons API-MMA has fights for, oldest first, as the years the Season fields take.
list_seasons.name: list_seasons

list_teams.description: Find the teams fighters train with, such as Eagles MMA, by name or ID. With no filter it lists all of them.
list_teams.name: list_teams

parameters.description: Optional. Only this team, by ID, such as 163.
parameters.name: team_id

parameters.description: Optional. Only names containing this, at least 3 characters.
parameters.name: search

id.description: The team's ID, such as 163 for Eagles MMA.

description: Follow mixed martial arts with API-MMA: every UFC fight since 2022 with its result and both fighters' statistics, fighters with their records, weight classes and training teams, and bookmakers' pre-match odds. Needs an API-SPORTS key; the free plan allows 100 requests a day.
